rust_summary: a block state read from and written as text, as `/setblock` takes it (`native_block_state_from_string`, `native_block_state_string`).
doc_summary: `native_block_state_from_string(text)` reads `oak_door[facing=east,open=true]` as a block state (`BlockStateParser.parseForBlock`, without block entity data) and `native_block_state_string(state)` writes one as `BlockStateParser.serialize` does.
